mistral.zero_spend_confirmation: existing user-confirmed Supabase flag; Pay-As-You-Go not changed
mistral.reason: Live account-bound inference and zero mandatory cost are proven; organization Free-mode/PAYG state is not exposed by the standard API key, so no daily capacity is certified.

openrouter.reason: OPENROUTER_API_KEY is absent from the current proof repository; no current account-bound capacity is promotable.

modal.blocker: authenticated workspace; Starter has recurring $30 compute credit but no hard environment budget, so automatic fallback remains disabled

cerebras.blocker: No Cerebras credential is present in the ARBM secure store; public plan quota alone is not account-specific evidence.

policy.mistral_diversity: Eligible Mistral receives deterministic one-in-four first positions; otherwise it is tried after existing FREE providers fail and before Cloudflare. Live and zero-spend gates always apply.
policy.mistral_cooldown: Provider-wide within each warm Edge isolate. 429 stops all model retries immediately; Retry-After seconds/date honored, default 120 seconds. No distributed cooldown guarantee is claimed.

gate.reason: Quantitative certifier is proven. Mistral has live TPM only; OpenRouter account is Free Tier but request-limited; Cerebras offers 1M TPD publicly but lacks ARBM account credential. Account-specific token/day evidence remains below 3M.

capacity_audit.method: Sum only independently verified, recurring daily free allowances. Unknown is excluded, never extrapolated from TPM, observed tokens, monthly averages or shared model pools.
capacity_audit.lightning_daily: UNKNOWN; inherited 30M/month claim is a monthly envelope, not a guaranteed daily floor
capacity_audit.groq_daily: UNKNOWN; inherited per-model table is not current account-wide quota evidence
capacity_audit.gemini_daily: UNKNOWN; dynamic limits with no quantitative independent daily allowance recorded
capacity_audit.zero_means: No quantitative daily allowance certified in this audit; not zero actual operating capacity.
